mapper.select: SELECT id, name, subtitle, price, original_price, main_image, sold_count, unit, is_recommended, is_hot, is_new FROM product WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY id , create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}

SELECT id, name, subtitle, price, original_price, main_image, sold_count, unit, status, is_recommended, is_hot, is_new FROM product WHERE status = 1 AND category_id = #{categoryId} ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT id, name, subtitle, description, price, original_price, main_image, category_id, merchant_id, sold_count, stock, unit, weight, is_recommended, is_hot, is_new, origin_place, brand, shelf_life, delivery_type, min_purchase, max_purchase, status, create_time, update_time FROM product WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1

SELECT id, name, subtitle, description, price, original_price, main_image, category_id, merchant_id, sold_count, stock, unit, weight, is_recommended, is_hot, is_new, origin_place, brand, shelf_life, delivery_type, min_purchase, max_purchase, status, create_time, update_time FROM product WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, name, subtitle, description, price, original_price, main_image, sold_count, stock, unit, is_recommended, is_hot, is_new FROM product WHERE status = 1 AND (name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR subtitle LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ORDER BY sold_count DESC LIMIT 50
mapper.update: UPDATE product SET name = #{name}, subtitle = #{subtitle}, description = #{description}, price = #{price}, original_price = #{originalPrice}, main_image = #{mainImage}, category_id = #{categoryId}, stock = #{stock}, unit = #{unit}, weight = #{weight}, shelf_life = #{shelfLife}, origin_place = #{originPlace}, brand = #{brand}, delivery_type = #{deliveryType}, is_recommended = #{isRecommended}, is_hot = #{isHot}, is_new = #{isNew}, status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE product SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product ( name, subtitle, description, price, original_price, main_image, category_id, merchant_id, stock, unit, shelf_life, origin_place, brand, delivery_type, is_recommended, is_hot, is_new, status, sold_count, view_count, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{name}, #{subtitle}, #{description}, #{price}, #{originalPrice}, #{mainImage}, #{categoryId}, #{merchantId}, #{stock}, #{unit}, #{shelfLife}, #{originPlace}, #{brand}, #{deliveryType}, #{isRecommended}, #{isHot}, #{isNew}, #{status}, #{soldCount}, #{viewCount}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, main_image, sold_count, price FROM product WHERE merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND status = 1 ORDER BY sold_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}
